name: Somatropin (growth hormone)
description: Recombinant human growth hormone, a 191-amino-acid protein given by injection under the skin

note.lead: Aging is not an approved use.
note.text: US federal law makes it a crime to distribute human growth hormone for any use FDA has not authorized, including anti-aging.

bullets: **Equivalent to pituitary growth hormone** in lab and clinical tests (label)
**Stimulates linear growth** in children; normalizes IGF-I in GH deficiency (label)
**In adults with GH deficiency,** less fat mass and more lean mass (label)
**In aging,** a benefit is not established; strength did not clearly rise
Approved for growth disorders since the 1980s

practical.halfLife: 3.0 hours under the skin (GHD adults); 0.4 hours IV
practical.pharmacokinetics: Protein breakdown in liver and kidneys (label)
practical.monitored: IGF-I levels, blood sugar, thyroid, cortisol, tumors

regulatory.text: Approved for growth disorders, GHD, HIV wasting
Distributing for unapproved uses is a crime

references: Ann Intern Med, growth hormone in healthy elderly: systematic review, Jan 2007
